test_status_creation: test creating an absl Status object with StatusCode.CANCELLED and a message string
test_status_or_passing: test passing a StatusOr object to check_statusor and verify error handling for OK status
test_make_status: test the make_status function to create OK and CANCELLED status objects without raising exceptions
test_status_not_ok_exception: test that return_status raises StatusNotOk with correct code and message for non-OK status codes
test_status_or_value_return: test return_value_status_or to verify it returns the wrapped int value on success and raises on failure
